[LGRA.10.1.6] **Services live in one global namespace, and a service reference is
bare.** A `service_ref` names a service by its own name, and the compiler must
resolve it against every service declared in the compilation's import closure,
whatever form imported the declaring library. The name alone identifies a service
([LCRS.14.9]), so no library qualifier is needed to reach one, and none is
admitted.

A `call` position is not resolved by scope ([LGRA.22.9]). A dotted path whose first
segment happens to name an imported library is a service name like any other, and
it resolves only if a service of that exact name is declared.
